protocol.engineering_decision: whether candidate variant B should replace baseline variant A for the evaluated concept proposal operation
protocol.hypothesis: explicitly requiring a raw JSON object without extra formatting or preamble will improve structural validity and eliminate parse failures while preserving source grounding and meaning coverage
protocol.semantic_acceptance: each configuration must achieve a rubric-acceptable rate of at least 0.75 over assessable responses with zero critical unsupported fabrications
protocol.blocking_failures: any critical unsupported claim (U category) or persistent structural invalidity constitutes a blocking failure
protocol.operational_acceptance: all attempts must return within 60.0 seconds from attempt start to response; unknown latency or usage values are treated as missing operational telemetry rather than zero
protocol.tradeoff_rule: variant B may replace variant A if it achieves higher or equal rubric acceptability and strictly avoids structural parse failures without introducing unsupported claims

decision_rule.recommend-b: candidate configuration B satisfies every blocking condition, demonstrates equal or superior structural and semantic acceptability, and justifies the replacement of variant A
decision_rule.retain-a: baseline configuration A satisfies all blocking conditions and candidate variant B fails to justify replacement or introduces regressions
decision_rule.reject-both: both candidate configurations violate one or more blocking conditions or fail minimum acceptance thresholds
decision_rule.seek-more-evidence: route unavailability, high sample uncertainty, or ambiguous evidence prevents a definitive engineering determination

protocol.timing_boundary: attempt start to terminal response recorded

change_declaration.mechanism: explicitly forbidding non-JSON preamble and markdown wrapping ensures the model response directly parses as a single valid JSON object under the output contract
